svg.title: Skill and knowledge propagation
svg.desc: A learning becomes a candidate, is classified and reviewed, then released as a versioned local, internal, or public artifact. Each consumer adopts the version through a reviewed change and supplies loading and outcome evidence. A separate upstream path reviews and pins an existing public artifact instead of copying it.
